question: How long did the first national emergency declared in October 1962 last?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1968.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The first national emergency in India was declared on October 26, 1962, due to the Sino-Indian War.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The emergency was declared by President Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.**
 
• This was the first time a national emergency was declared in independent India.
 
• The emergency lasted until January 10, 1968.
 
• It was declared under Article 352 of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• National Emergency in India__

 __
 
• National Emergency can be declared under Article 352 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It can be declared in case of war, external aggression, or armed rebellion.
 
• During a national emergency, the federal structure of the country becomes unitary.
 
• Fundamental Rights under Article 19 are automatically suspended during a National Emergency.
 
 
 
• Historical Context__
 
 
• The 1962 emergency was declared due to the Sino-Indian War, which was fought between India and China.
 
• This war highlighted the inadequacies in India's defense preparedness.
 
• The conflict ended in November 1962, but the emergency continued to ensure national security and internal stability.
